{"items":[
{"item_id":"h031","prompts":["My HarmonyOS app keeps crashing when users open the settings page on the physical device, and I've saved the exported log bundle (crash-20240511.zip) to my desktop. Here is a snippet from the crash log: 'Fault thread info: Tid: 12345, Name: com.example.app, #00 pc 000000000001a2b4 /system/lib/ld-musl-aarch64.so. Please walk me through how to pull the full logs with hilog, unzip and analyze the crash dump, and figure out what caused the fault."],"rubric":["Explains relevant hilog commands for capturing/filtering logs and how to produce a log export/archive","Shows how to extract and read the crash log / fault thread stack dump from the bundle","Interprets the provided stack trace and points to a likely cause or next diagnostic step"]},
{"item_id":"h032","prompts":["I need to hand a proper requirements design doc to my team for a new feature: a bookmark-syncing reading list in our app. Please generate the full document covering the feature description, typical user scenarios and flows, the API contracts between client and server, a detailed implementation plan, and automated test case definitions. Assume the client is ArkTS and the backend offers REST endpoints like POST /bookmarks and GET /bookmarks/sync."],"rubric":["Document includes feature description/requirements definition section","Includes scenario analysis and user flow section","Includes API/interface specification and a detailed implementation plan","Includes defined automated test cases for the feature"]},
{"item_id":"h033","prompts":["My video player app on HarmonyOS should rotate to landscape when the user goes fullscreen on a phone, but on a foldable in the unfolded state the window stays in the wrong orientation, and I've heard there are special handling rules for the tri-fold 'G state'. Please analyze the requirement and show me how to correctly set the preferred orientation, configure the module.json5, and handle rotation for foldables and follow-desktop behavior, with code fixes."],"rubric":["Covers setting preferred orientation in code and orientation config in module.json5","Addresses foldable-unfolded and/or tri-fold orientation handling","Provides concrete ArkTS code example or fix","Explains how to verify the orientation behavior"]},
{"item_id":"h034","prompts":["I just wrote unit tests in the default module of my HarmonyOS app (entry/src/test/List.test.ets, suites CalculatorTest and StringUtilsTest) and I want to run only the CalculatorTest suite and see coverage numbers before pushing. Explain how to run local unit tests for that specific suite on my machine, including the commands/modes available for coverage, and what a passing run's output looks like."],"rubric":["Describes how to run local (ArkTS/JS) unit tests for a module","Shows how to limit the run to a specific test suite or case","Mentions coverage statistics mode and how to obtain it","Explains expected output or how to interpret results"]},
{"item_id":"h035","prompts":["Our security team flagged that our HarmonyOS app is logging user phone numbers and tokens at DEBUG level in files like these: `hilog.debug(0x0000, 'Login', 'user phone=%{public}s token=%{public}s', phone, token);` and `console.info('order detail: ' + JSON.stringify(user));`. Please review the logging rules for user data and produce a remediation guide: which levels user data may or may not be printed at, how to fix these lines, and a checklist for the whole codebase."],"rubric":["States clear rules on permissible log levels for user/personal data","Provides corrected versions of the example logging statements","Includes a checklist or step-by-step remediation guidance for scanning the codebase"]},
{"item_id":"h036","prompts":["I'm converting my existing HarmonyOS app into an atomic service that installs on demand, and I'm hitting several walls: the @atomicservice APIs throw errors, my package is over the size limit, I'm not sure how to configure privacy hosting and trusted domains, and I need silent login. Please give me the conversion steps, a compliance checklist, and code examples covering these problems, plus guidance on whether to use the enhanced web component instead of ArkWeb."],"rubric":["Covers creating/converting a project into an atomic service","Addresses at least package size, privacy hosting, and trusted domain configuration","Includes code examples for @atomicservice usage and/or silent login","Mentions the AtomicServiceEnhancedWeb vs ArkWeb choice and submission/compliance tips"]},
{"item_id":"h037","prompts":["I have a large model class in ArkTS that I want to share across concurrent worker threads, but the compiler rejects it because it isn't sendable-compliant. Here's the class: `class Profile { name: string = ''; tags: string[] = []; cache: Map<string, number> = new Map(); update(k: string, v: number) { this.cache.set(k, v); } }`. Please refactor this code to follow the sendable rules, splitting classes if needed, and verify it would compile."],"rubric":["Identifies which parts violate sendable constraints (e.g., Map/Array usage) and explains why","Produces refactored code with @Sendable-conformant structures and correct sharing strategy","Splits or restructures classes as needed rather than just adding annotations","Mentions a compile/verification step for the transformed code"]},
{"item_id":"h038","prompts":["In my OpenHarmony source tree I want to expose a system service to developers as a command-line tool. For example, the battery manager SA at base/services/battery/battery_service exposes an inner_kit with an IBatteryInterface IDL. Walk me through the process of exploring those inner APIs, checking what permissions they require, and packaging them into an executable CLI tool with an ohos- prefixed command, including the build verification and a final report of what was done."],"rubric":["Describes exploring SA/inner_kit/IDL interfaces in the OHOS source tree","Includes permission analysis for the wrapped system capabilities","Produces a CLI tool design with ohos- or hms- style command naming","Mentions build verification and a generated report of the process"]},
{"item_id":"h039","prompts":["My HarmonyOS gallery app currently only handles touch events for selecting and dragging photos, and I've been told it must work equally well with a mouse, keyboard, and stylus. I need an adaptation plan showing how to unify the input events, add hover highlights and right-click context menus for mouse users, support keyboard focus navigation and shortcuts (e.g., Ctrl+A to select all), and handle stylus pressure and palm rejection. Include ArkTS event handling code."],"rubric":["Presents an input-unification/normalization strategy for touch, mouse, keyboard, and stylus","Includes concrete ArkTS code for hover and/or right-click menu behavior","Covers keyboard focus navigation and at least one shortcut","Addresses stylus-specific behavior such as pressure or hover"]},
{"item_id":"h040","prompts":["My ArkTS module fails the strict static compile check with errors like: 'arkts-strict-typing: Property 'items' has no explicit type', 'arkts-no-untyped-obj-literals: Object literals must have a declared type', and 'arkts-limited-standalone-this'. Here's the code: `let data = { items: [] }; function handler() { console.log(this.data.items); } class Repo { load() { let r = fetch('/x'); return r; } }`. Please fix all the static compile errors so the file passes the strict ArkTS checks."],"rubric":["Adds explicit types to untyped variables and object literals","Resolves the 'this' usage violation appropriately","Fixes typing issues around the async/return value in the example","All corrections target arkts strict static compile rules, not just runtime behavior"]}
]}
